tools.name: gisdb_search_catalog
tools.description: Find county records packages and directory listings. Check each package's availability, price, source coverage and limits before buying. A county listing does not confirm lead, assessment or CAD coverage.

tools.name: gisdb_get_metadata
tools.description: Read a county records package's verified details, source coverage, missing facts and limits. Returns unavailable when no verified package exists. CAD compatibility and the current tax year are not assumed.

tools.name: gisdb_search_records
tools.description: Search recorded county property facts or repeated owner-name groups. Use property_records for address, parcel or owner-name searches, or owner_portfolios for unfiltered groups. Property records allow 1–250 rows and offsets through 1000000; groups allow 1–100 rows without query, signal or offset. JSO

tools.name: gisdb_guide_search
tools.description: Find available property records, owner-name groups, lead packages or county downloads. Ask one next_question at a time. Accept unknown or skipped answers and resend previous answers and skipped IDs. Returns source coverage, previews and available offers. No sign-in or purchase required. Unsupported

tools.name: gisdb_start_search
tools.description: Save this GISDB search to the connected account. Reuse the same idempotency_key if the result is uncertain. Does not buy, subscribe or send anything.

tools.name: gisdb_continue_search
tools.description: Continue this saved search with its latest revision and all previous answers and skips. Review any changed source or offer. Reuse a retry key only with identical arguments.

tools.name: gisdb_get_search
tools.description: Reopen this account's saved search and recheck its sources and offers. Keep the user's preferences and ask them to confirm any changed source or offer.

tools.name: gisdb_save_search
tools.description: Name and save this account's search. Saving does not buy a subscription or start updates. Use the current revision and a stable retry key.

tools.name: gisdb_list_saved_searches
tools.description: List this connected GISDB account's saved searches, with their workflow IDs and revisions. Reopen a search to check its source before calling it current.

tools.name: gisdb_create_checkout
tools.description: Create a secure payment link for the selected reviewed records, lead or subscription offer. First show its price, coverage, update frequency, renewal and cancellation terms and get the user's purchase request. Card details stay on the hosted page. Reuse the original idempotency_key if the response i

tools.name: gisdb_get_order
tools.description: Check the same account's order after checkout or an uncertain result. Verifies payment, subscription, access and delivery separately. Use only its returned order_id. A payment link or confirmed payment does not prove files were delivered.

tools.name: gisdb_open_billing_portal
tools.description: Open secure billing for this account's order or subscription when the user asks. Payment details stay on the hosted page. Read the order after returning to confirm any change; opening the page alone confirms nothing.

tools.name: gisdb_cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel the selected subscription's renewal at the end of its paid period, only when the user asks. Returns confirmed renewal and access status. Pausing updates does not cancel renewal.

tools.name: gisdb_get_lead_updates
tools.description: Read this account's saved-search updates, delivery revision, source dates, check times and available downloads. Only a successful source check can establish no new records. Failed checks keep the last successful result. Subscription and delivery status are separate.

tools.name: gisdb_set_lead_updates
tools.description: Pause or resume updates for this saved search when the user asks. Read updates first, then use its delivery revision and a stable retry key. Pausing does not cancel renewal. Resuming requires verified paid access and source checks and cannot override a newer pause.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "gisdb_list_saved_searches" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List this connected GISDB account's saved searches, with their workflow IDs and revisions. Reopen a search to check its source before calling it current.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gisdb_continue_search · Private data: gisdb_search_catalog, gisdb_get_metadata, gisdb_search_records, gisdb_guide_search, gisdb_create_checkout, gisdb_get_order, gisdb_get_lead_updates · Public sink: gisdb_start_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gisdb_continue_search · Private data: gisdb_search_catalog, gisdb_get_metadata, gisdb_search_records, gisdb_guide_search, gisdb_create_checkout, gisdb_get_order, gisdb_get_lead_updates · Public sink: gisdb_start_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
